rationale: Describes conventional telecom billing and operations software: real-time charging and policy controls, ordering and provisioning, a web customer care application, a business intelligence layer for analytics, and a notifications engine. a robust ordering and provisioning system, a business intelligence layer for analytics and a customer notifications engine
